svg.text: 1 EMS bus input: fuses, filter, Schottky bridge, clamp
2 Buck converter JW5017S: rectified bus (VIN) to 5 V (V5_EMS)
3 RX path: bus level -> comparator U1A -> OC1 (EMS to MCU)
4 TX path: OC2 -> comparator U1B -> Q1 bus load (MCU to EMS, drawn right to left)
10 ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (U3, DNP) with reset, boot, LED, test pads
EMS SIDE (GND_EMS): galvanically isolated, bus powered
